recent.text: Zavion Thomas was WIDE OPEN.
recent.author: Nicholas Moreano

recent.text: Detroit forgot about Zavion Thomas on that play. He was wide open for a touchdown behind the defense. Caleb didn't see him. #Bears

recent.text: Lions were wise to take safety instead of declining penalty, as it turned out. Nine points > seven. That was a bad half for the #Bears, who didn’t take care of the football — again. They’re still in it but need to tighten up pass defense in secondary and protect football.
recent.author: David Haugh

recent.text: This is a talented #Bears team that has just looked out of sorts these last three weeks They’re still in this game, but stupid mistakes on both sides of the ball are costing them. Ball security has been atrocious
recent.author: Jacob Infante

recent.text: #Bears down 19-10 heading into the half. They’ve been dominated on both sides of the ball in the trenches. Simply put, they need a TD coming out of the half or this one might get out of hand in a hurry.
recent.author: Aaron Leming

recent.text: How big was that call on the Jared Goff fumble challenge? #Bears went from possibly having the ball in DET territory to now down 9 at halftime.

recent.text: Lions double up after the safety with a Jared Goff touchdown to Sam LaPorta to wrap up an eventful first half. Lions 19, Bears 10. The Bears had the ball at the two-minute warning with a 10-10 tie.
